conclusion: All three predeclared overall approximate confidence intervals cross zero. V7 has not demonstrated a stable gain over E or T; keep the product default and continue development.

method.frozenText: All three declared paired comparisons; equal-weight configurations within each seed, then 40 seed means, sample SE and mean +/-1.96SE. All overall/opening/lineup panels, seven income components, four-seat sensitivity panels and every same-prefix first divergence. No acceptance threshold, no partial-score inspection or favorable subset selection.
method.calculation: Exact rational within-seed means and sample variance (ddof=1); SE=sqrt(sample variance/40); mean +/-1.96SE.
method.income: Seven own-seat ledger deltas, same full equal-weight grid; exact mean before float conversion.
method.signCounts: betterSeedFraction = positiveSeeds / seedCount; zero seeds stay in the denominator but not the numerator.
